rule: A forecast's criterion source must be a data source OUTSIDE the firm. Forecasting a file the firm itself writes is the ruler measuring itself: the author controls the outcome, and the resulting Brier score measures nothing about the world. Registration refuses any source not listed here, and refuses any source naming a path inside the repository.
reason: F00001 and F00002 were registered against JOURNAL.jsonl on 2026-08-21 - forecasts about the firm's own defect stream, one of which the author could satisfy by deciding to. The principal caught it: the firm is in survey phase and is not doing predictions yet. Withdrawn, and this gate added so the write path refuses the class rather than relying on judgment.
